card.name: Linking words before a drug name
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as to, with, on, receiving and and, right before a named drug, drug class or comparison. Found in label text on combination use, hypersensitivity and exposure.

modes.label: Use with another drug
modes.description: A linking word after adjunct, therapy or receiving that introduces a co-administered drug.
modes.example: in adults is 15 mg given once daily as monotherapy and 10 mg to 15 mg given once daily as adjunctive therapy<< with>> lithium or valproate. Arip

modes.label: Reaction or comparison to a drug
modes.description: A word like to or with after a reaction, similarity or product description, before the drug or class it relates to.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words that come just before the name of a drug or drug class.
